name: ColdStart

patterns: Affirmation framing: 'Yes. X can do that.'
Direct second-person address: 'Your team is doing X manually...'
Quantified claims: '100x Faster' as standalone headline
Punctuation as rhythm — full stops mid-line for spoken-cadence feel
anti_patterns: Corporate softening: 'we believe', 'we think', 'we can help you explore'
Buzzword stacking: 'leverage cutting-edge AI to synergize'
Hedged claims: 'up to X in some cases'
Apologizing for AI: 'we know AI feels overwhelming...'
voice.audience: B2B sales / marketing / RevOps teams. Decision-makers (founders, VPs, ops leads) who already suspect AI applies to their workflows but haven't shipped it. Outcomes-focused, not implementation-focused.
voice.positioning: ColdStart is the bridge between B2B teams and AI capability — specifically Claude implementation.

ops.heygen_avatar_id_note: HeyGen talking_photo Look ID (Avatar V motion engine via use_avatar_v_model:true; falls back to Avatar IV if the Look is not V-enrolled). Set per account.
ops.pronunciation_dict_note: Seed list — extend as Phase A surfaces mispronunciations. Add: any client names, technical jargon, acronyms.

inconsistencies_flagged: Site declares --font-display: 'Unbounded' but it's never used — all display text renders in Cabinet Grotesk. Either drop or commit.
Two contradictory body-font variables (--font-body: Inter vs --_typography---fonts--body: Cabinet Grotesk); actual usage is Inter.
Brand 'primary' color #ff8b48 (orange) doesn't appear in the captured viewport — periwinkle #8b9cf7 carries the visual emphasis. Confirm orange usage below the fold before promoting it.
Relume-default tokens (--text-color--text-primary, --background-color--background-primary) left from template, inverted from actual dark-theme usage.
Two near-duplicate accents: #8b9cf7 and #c4a0f7 — assign distinct roles or merge.
Eyebrow at 10.4px / 55% opacity is below WCAG-readable size and contrast.
Lead body at 300 weight / 55% opacity is the riskiest legibility combo on the page.
